title: Senior Deputy Manager at Inventec Expects AVC’s AI Server Cooling-System Costs to Rise With Increasing Thermal Demands
expert: Senior Deputy Manager at Inventec (AI-server ODM), 10+ years; sees Inventec's own AVC allocations and procurement
verdict: Inventec's own AVC procurement is roughly flat vs the prior two years, even as AVC's China and Vietnam capacity is fully loaded with orders booked 1–2 years ahead.

Nvidia content and share: 🔴 Inventec AVC procurement roughly flat vs prior two years (first-hand) vs +4–5% q/q in the 2026-11-09 Jabil call: conflicting.
🔴 Vera Rubin cooling quotes +10–25% per rack vs GB200 (estimate) vs +50% content per tray (SB #58854): lower. → Tenet 1 (Rubin content and share) ↓
Gross margin: 🟢 AVC corporate yield 80–90% vs ~80% Rubin yield in the 2026-11-06 and 2026-11-07 calls. → Tenet 3 (GM 34%+) ↑
🔴 Rubin backplane 20–30% more complex (estimate); margin risk if costs are not passed through, first read.
Rubin yield and ramp: 🟢 Capacity fully loaded, orders booked 1–2 years ahead, consistent with Citi's 2027 demand ahead of supply (SB #54848). → Tenet 4 (capacity) ↑
